We have spent a lifetime learning and loving the intricacies that define the myriad forms of lives in the sea. This is an homage to that obsession. An exquisite representation of the finest seafood from the shores of the Mediterranean, crafted with an immaculate attention to detail, using specially chosen ingredients, all under the masterful guidance of the captain of this cruise, Chef Vijayan Parakkal.
